title: Data Engineer
description:
BI Data Engineer - Berkshire - Hybrid - Up to £61,000

The Role

An established, data-driven organisation is seeking a Principal BI Engineer to lead the evolution of its business intelligence and data platform capabilities. This is a strategic, hands-on role for an experienced BI professional who thinks beyond dashboard delivery and focuses on building scalable, trusted data products.

You will play a key role in modernising a legacy reporting environment and shaping a cloud-native analytics platform, while maintaining high-quality business reporting and strong stakeholder engagement. The role calls for a blend of technical leadership, platform architecture expertise and a strong commercial understanding of business performance metrics.

Key Skills & Experience


  • 5+ years' experience in BI, Analytics Engineering or Data Engineering roles.
  • Proven ownership of critical reporting platforms and business-facing data products.
  • Hands-on production experience with Azure Databricks.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Experience operating within business and technology transformation programmes.
  • A platform-first mindset focused on reusable, scalable solutions.
  • Azure Stack experience.

Why Apply?

  • Gain valuable experience utilising the tools to shape a modern data platform.
  • Opportunity to build leadership skills in a challenging work environment.
  • Be part of a goal-driven team.
  • Join an organisation who think forward when it comes to Data and AI.
